meta.name: google-maps-scraper
meta.description: Free and open-source Google Maps scraper using Docker. Use when the user wants to find businesses, extract leads, emails, reviews, or ratings from Google Maps. Triggers on requests like "find all <business type> in <city>", "scrape Google Maps for <keyword>", "get leads from Google Maps". Keywords: google maps, scrape, business, leads, restaurants, shops, places, reviews, ratings, emails, contacts.

copy.tagline: 从谷歌地图批量提取商家线索和联系方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从谷歌地图批量获取商家信息和联系方式
copy.tagline_en: Extract business leads and contacts from Google Maps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to bulk extract business info and contacts from Google Maps

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的要求，用 Docker 自动从 Google Maps 抓取商家信息、联系方式、评论和评分，并以表格形式展示结果。
howto.when: 当你提出“找一下<城市>的<商家类型>”、“抓取 Google Maps 上关于<关键词>的信息”或“获取 Google Maps 上的线索”等请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下柏林的所有牙医。
say.note: Claude 会启动抓取，完成后展示结果表格。

say.text: 抓取纽约曼哈顿的咖啡店，深度设为中等。
say.note: Claude 会按中等深度（约100条结果）抓取。

say.text: 获取伦敦的餐厅列表，并提取邮箱。
say.note: Claude 会抓取餐厅信息并尝试提取邮箱地址。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically scrape business listings, contact details, reviews, and ratings from Google Maps using Docker, and present results in a table.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to find businesses in a city, scrape Google Maps for a keyword, or get leads from Google Maps.

say_en.note: Claude will start scraping and show results.

say_en.text: Scrape coffee shops in Manhattan, New York with medium depth.
say_en.note: Claude will scrape with medium depth (~100 results).

say_en.text: Get restaurant listings in London and extract emails.
say_en.note: Claude will scrape restaurants and try to extract emails.
